_comment: Feed for the front-page ticker. The countdown item is computed by js/main.js from countdown.date. To refresh the ticker, edit items[] here - each item is one marquee entry. Keep texts short (one line). This file is hand-curated from @SetlistLizard posts for now; the bot could write it directly some day.

items.text: Dick's 2026 is in the books - 44 songs over three nights, closing with First Tube > Tweezer Reprise
Saturday's Tweezer went unresolved. Sunday's encore paid it off. That is the whole trick.
Sunday's Fuego ran 20:35 - longest song of the run
Next up: three nights at Boardwalk Hall, Atlantic City, Oct 2-4
October after that: Richmond, Jacksonville, and two nights at the Orion in Huntsville
Follow @SetlistLizard for live Phish setlists, one song at a time - data via Phish.net
@SetlistHound is in the yard warming up - Dogs in a Pile setlists, first bark soon
